title: Money Talk

vocab.pt: Viver de acordo com seus recursos

expressions.expr: Could you tell me how much this costs?
expressions.meaning: Você poderia me dizer quanto isso custa?
expressions.example: Could you tell me how much this trip will cost?

expressions.expr: Do you know how much she earns?
expressions.example: Do you know how much she earns per month?

expressions.expr: I was wondering how much you spend monthly
expressions.meaning: Eu queria saber quanto você gasta por mês
expressions.example: I was wondering how much you spend monthly on rent.

expressions.expr: Can you tell me what your budget is?
expressions.meaning: Você pode me dizer qual é o seu orçamento?
expressions.example: Can you tell me what your monthly budget looks like?

grammar.title: Indirect Questions
rules: Perguntas indiretas usam ordem afirmativa (sujeito + verbo), não invertida: Could you tell me how much this costs?
Frases introdutórias comuns: Could you tell me...?, Do you know...?, I was wondering...
Em perguntas indiretas com "be", o verbo também segue a ordem normal: Do you know what your budget is?
Perguntas indiretas soam mais educadas, ideais para falar de dinheiro sem parecer intrusivo.

rows: Could you tell me + wh- + subject + verb?
Could you tell me how much this costs?
Do you know + wh- + subject + verb?

I was wondering + wh- + subject + verb

Do you know what your budget is?
